_what: The noncredit subject title list, drafted from the subject headings of the four large noncredit programs' catalogs only (Sam, 2026-11-21, relayed by COBIx on #3655). Each title lists the headings printed for it, the programs that print it, and the COCI noncredit category its courses sit under, counted from the export, with that category's noncredit MQ discipline and common subject code where one exists. A draft for a person to settle: nothing reads it as a title or a mapping, and the noncredit hold stands. Built by kb/_build_noncredit_subject_titles.py; no clock is read.
_rule: Two headings are one title when they are equal after folding case, '&', punctuation and a trailing campus mark, or when the synonym list names them: English as a Second Language (esl classes, english as a second language, esl); Basic Skills (adult basic education, basic skills); Parent Education (parenting, parent education); Older Adults (emeritus, older adult, older adults). Nothing else is merged. state says one category where 90% or more of a title's noncredit courses sit under one category, several categories otherwise.
